items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Well the band was just for myself, Joe Oliver, Kei Ori, Johnny Dot, Lorenzo Stahl, banjo player, Bob Lyon, bass player.

ctx.x: Who else was in the band when you joined Ori?
Well the band was just for myself, Joe Oliver, Kei Ori, Johnny Dot, Lorenzo Stahl, banjo player, Bob Lyon, bass player.
Excuse me, how's Lorenzo Stahl spelled his last name? Is it S-T-A-L-L? Do you remember?

items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: It was Ory and Oliver's jazz band.

ctx.x: You played violin there with Oliver. Was Kedori in the band then?
It was Ory and Oliver's jazz band. I was leading the band.

Yeah. With my band, I just, the way it happened that Oliver used to come around where we played at Lincoln Park and St. Catherine Hall and various places he was working. And so he said, why, why don't you give him a chance sometime? I said, well, when you get good enough. But I'm trying. I said, okay. So finally, Papa Mudd dropped out. You know, you had to do your day job or you couldn't do the job. And I told him, it was best for him to try to hold one job. If you want the other job, I'll have to get someone…
